import subprocess
import threading

def worker(argv):
    subprocess.run(argv)

timer = threading.Timer(0, worker, kwargs={"argv": ["pacman", "-Q", "r22-timer-run-alias"]})
timer.run()

Exactly one argv is statically determined; shlex.join of the literal tokens is 'pacman -Q r22-timer-run-alias'. pacman -Q is a package query, not a host mutation. All bindings are literal and module-local, so the row is observed, not lead, and zero tokens are unparsed. Static truth therefore is exactly one package_query observed row and nothing else. This exercises the F4-open .run path on a scheduled binding (Timer, not Thread) with kwargs supplied at construction; nothing is awaited asynchronously in the semantics relevant to argv truth.
